title: VSETT LCD NFC Display
body_html:
The VSETT LCD NFC Display – This original VSETT throttle and NFC card combination is designed specifically for VSETT series electric scooters, including the VSETT models.

Experience a new level of convenience and control with the VSETT LCD NFC Display. The throttle display provides essential information such as battery voltage, speed, number of gears, and trip time, allowing you to stay informed and in control of your ride.

With the built-in NFC card functionality, accessing the display is a breeze. Simply touch the NFC reader with your card, and the screen will activate, providing you with the information you need at a glance. Say goodbye to complicated setup processes and enjoy seamless and effortless interaction with your scooter's display.

To ensure accurate information display, it is important to select your battery voltage. The VSETT LCD NFC Display offers six voltage options: 24V, 36V, 48V, 52V, 60V, and 72V. Setting your desired voltage is easy with the following steps:

  1. Press the power button to turn on the display.
  2. Use your NFC card to activate the screen.
  3. Press and hold the + and - buttons simultaneously for three seconds.
  4. Press the power button to navigate to P3.
  5. Use the + or - buttons to select your preferred battery voltage.

Customize your LCD display to match your scooter's specifications and enjoy accurate and reliable information throughout your rides. With the VSETT LCD NFC Display, you have full control over your scooter's settings and can optimize your riding experience to suit your preferences.

title: VSETT 10+ Battery
body_html:
The VSETT 10+ Battery, a high-performance power source designed to elevate your electric scooter experience. This lithium battery offers numerous advantages over traditional lead-acid batteries, including a longer lifespan and reduced weight.

With double the life expectancy of lead-acid batteries, this lithium battery ensures long-lasting performance for extended periods of use. Say goodbye to memory effect as this rechargeable battery maintains its efficiency over time, providing a longer battery life compared to its counterparts.

Safety and environmental consciousness are at the forefront of this battery's design. Free from heavy metals and hazardous substances, it offers a safer and more eco-friendly solution for your electric scooter. The built-in IC chip adds an extra layer of protection, preventing overcharging, over-discharging, over-current, over-heating, and short circuits. This advanced feature safeguards both the battery and your scooter from potential damage.

Mechanical accidents caused by vibration are also mitigated with this battery. Its construction minimizes the risk of such incidents, ensuring a smooth and secure ride every time.

Additionally, the battery is equipped with a BMS (Battery Management System) that incorporates load control, discharge protection, cell balancing, and thermal protection. The BMS ensures optimal performance, protects against premature wear, and maximizes the battery's lifespan.

To replace the battery of your VSETT 10+ electric scooter and enhance its longevity, it is important to follow a few steps carefully.

1- Ensure your safety by wearing protective gloves to avoid any risk of electrocution. 2- Turn off your scooter and place it on a flat surface.
3- Open the compartment where the battery is located, documenting the controller connections for future reference.
4- Check for any water infiltration and allow it to dry if present.
5- Disconnect the battery and auxiliary connections, remove the old battery, and install the new one.
